prompt_en: Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original K-pop-idol-inspired woman in her mid-twenties with a distinct fictional face. The casting remains an original adult fashion model. She has luminous porcelain-pale skin, long glossy dark hair, and a slender athletic silhouette. She wears a sleek one-piece swimsuit in opaque matte fabric. The swimsuit is deep navy blue with wide straps, a clean neckline, and a full-coverage cut. At a bright ocean waterline, she stands barefoot in a three-quarter front view, her torso angled about 45 degrees toward the camera while her face turns softly toward the lens. Frame her from head to mid-calf in a tighter vertical composition from a restrained low camera position in front and slightly to one side, keeping the upper legs large enough to read. Her legs stay gently adducted with the knees close. The actual upper inner-thigh contours remain visibly separate above the close knees and form clean opposing boundaries. A small triangular background opening filled with bright pale beach sits between them, creating true anatomical negative space and a readable thigh gap. The appealing focal geometry is deliberate yet subtle near the center of the crop. The opening is bordered by skin contours, not shadow, swimsuit fabric, or space below separated knees. Keep the narrow triangular opening clearly readable at thumbnail scale. Warm late-afternoon sunlight traces her hair, shoulders, and legs; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon create polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling. Keep the mood confident and calm.
